scope: Fictional local demonstration; approval records locally and does not print, charge or send a job.
rules: One copy consumes one sheet; remaining sheets = selected paper availableSheets minus copies. The local preview does not decrement shared stock.
Copies must be an integer from1 through selected paper availability. Empty,0,negative,fractional or above-stock values cannot reach approval.
Recycled White is visibly unavailable and cannot be chosen.
Changing paper when a valid quantity exceeds its stock clamps to that stock and announces the change. Other invalid input retains feedback; never show an apparently valid stale total.
First approval attempt fails; retry succeeds. Keep job, paper and copies through review/edit/failure/retry. Editing clears old success. Return to queue preserves query/status filters and selection.
